title: Reach Customers Across YouTube & Search - Google Ads

facts.fact: Google states that multiple campaigns can be created in the same Google Ads account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: Google Ads states new advertisers can choose an offer to earn up to $4500 in ad credit to jumpstart their first campaign.
facts.quote: Choose an offer to earn up to **$4500** in ad credit and jumpstart your first campaign.

facts.fact: Google Ads Offer A provides $500 in ad credit if the advertiser spends $500 with Google Ads in the first 60 days.
facts.quote: Spend $500 with Google Ads in the first 60 days to unlock the credit.

facts.fact: Google Ads Offer B provides $2000 in ad credit if the advertiser spends $1500 with Google Ads in the first 60 days.
facts.quote: Spend $1500 with Google Ads in the first 60 days to unlock the credit.

facts.fact: Google Ads Offer C provides $4500 in ad credit if the advertiser spends $3000 with Google Ads in the first 60 days.
facts.quote: Spend $3000 with Google Ads in the first 60 days to unlock the credit.

facts.fact: Under the Google Ads sign-up offers, new advertisers receive the ad credit only after meeting the minimum spend requirement for the selected offer.
facts.quote: New advertisers will receive an ad credit after meeting the minimum spend requirement for the selected offer.

facts.fact: Google Ads sign-up offers require the advertiser to sign up and complete payment setup to apply the offer to the account.
facts.quote: Sign up and complete payment setup to apply the offer to your account.

facts.fact: Google Ads states that its sign-up offer for the $500 credit requires completing billing setup to redeem the offer.
facts.quote: Sign up and complete billing setup to redeem your offer.

facts.fact: Google's page states that 67% of users who encounter brands on social media are subsequently influenced by Google Search to buy a different brand.
facts.quote: notably, 67% of users who encounter brands on social media are subsequently influenced by Google Search to buy a different brand.1

facts.fact: Google's page says that PensionBee reported App downloads increased by over 400% in 6 months, and notes performance statistics are specific to the advertiser and may vary.
facts.unit: % increase in app downloads over 6 months
facts.quote: “We’ve seen App downloads increase by over 400% in 6 months.” PensionBee

facts.fact: Google's page says Octopus Energy reported that its clicks increased by nine times with Google.
facts.quote: “With Google, our clicks increased by nine times.” Octopus Energy

facts.fact: Google's page shows a Shopping ad badge claiming +37% ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) as an example in its measurement module.
facts.quote: A badge in the corner reads “+37% ROAS’ (Return on Ad Spend).

facts.fact: Google's page states that Performance Max campaigns are AI-powered and can reach customers across Search, YouTube, Maps, and other Google surfaces based on the advertiser's chosen goals.
facts.quote: Simply set your goals (like sales, leads, store visits, etc.), and Google AI automatically finds your most profitable customers

facts.fact: Google's page describes Google Ads as connecting businesses to data sources such as Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager so AI can learn from signals and improve campaign performance.
facts.quote: connect your data sources, like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager, so AI can learn from your signals and improve campaign performance.

facts.fact: Google's page lists Google Search, YouTube, Google Play, and Discover among the Google-owned properties and partner networks where Google Ads can appear.
facts.quote: Google Ads can appear across various Google-owned properties and partner networks, including:

facts.fact: Google's page describes Video Reach campaigns as best for maximising reach and brand awareness on YouTube, including Shorts.
facts.quote: these campaigns are the best for maximising reach and brand awareness.

facts.fact: Google's page describes Shopping ads as best for retailers, showing products with photos, prices, and reviews across Google and YouTube surfaces.
facts.quote: Best for retailers, these visually engaging ads highlight your online or local store inventory with rich details like photos, prices, and reviews
